Package net.sf.sevenzipjbinding.impl Description

This package contains the implementation of some interfaces defined in net.sf.sevenzipjbinding. It also contains some handy utility classes for working with 7-Zip-JBinding.
Since:
4.65-1
Author:
Boris Brodski
